description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)获取当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
日志存储地域ID。


> 您可以通过调用[DescribeUserSlsLogRegions](~~2712598~~)接口查询用户可用的日志存储地域。
description.en:
The ID of the region where logs are stored.

> You can call the [DescribeUserSlsLogRegions](~~2712598~~) operation to query available log storage regions.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-sls-projects --instance-id waf_v3_public_cn-uqm2z00000a --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
